CustomField.description: Implemented as a part of the MSP Simplification and FY25 Partner Redesign projects. Jira ticket SS-7727
CustomField.formula: IF(TEXT(Incumbent_Partner_Override__c) = 'TRUE', TRUE, IF(TEXT(Incumbent_Partner_Override__c) = 'FALSE', FALSE, IF(Account__c = Opportunity__r.SBQQ__RenewedContract__r.SBQQ__Quote__r.Downstream_Reseller__c, TRUE, IF(Account__c = Opportunity__r.SBQQ__RenewedContract__r.SBQQ__Quote__r.SBQQ__Partner__c, TRUE, FALSE))))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When this box is checked, it indicates that this partner was the partner of record on the quote related to the contract that this opportunity renews.
CustomField.label: Incumbent Partner (formula)
